description: This file defines the SelectedDisplayField entity class in a PHP project using Doctrine ORM. It models the relationship between display fields and reports within the OrangeHRM system, including properties, getters, setters, and ORM mapping annotations.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayField
classes.description: An entity representing a selected display field associated with a report in the OrangeHRM system, including ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected display field entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the selected display field entity.

methods.name: getDisplayField
methods.description: Retrieves the DisplayField associated with this selected display field.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the DisplayField associated with this selected display field.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the Report associated with this selected display field.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Sets the Report associated with this selected display field.
